items.followUp: Briefly describe the career of agriculture.

rubric.why: Identifies horticulture as the growing or cultivation of plants.
rubric.description: States that horticulture involves growing or cultivating plants.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying horticulture as growing or cultivating plants.

rubric.why: Names examples of plants grown in horticulture.
rubric.description: Gives an example of a horticultural crop or plant.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming fruits, vegetables, flowers, or ornamental plants.

modelAnswer: Horticulture is the science and career concerned with growing and managing fruits, vegetables, flowers, and ornamental plants.
Horticulturists may work in nurseries, gardens, parks, or landscaping.

rubric.why: Filtration separates insoluble solid particles from a liquid.
rubric.description: States that filtration separates insoluble solids from a liquid.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying the substances separated.

rubric.why: Filtration passes a mixture through a filter or porous material.
rubric.description: Mentions using a filter or porous material.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying the filtering method.

modelAnswer: Filtration is the process of separating insoluble solid particles from a liquid by passing the mixture through a filter or other porous material.
